column1: Nurse administered 10mg of Morphine instead of prescribed 5mg to patient. Patient experienced drowsiness but recovered without complications.
Pharmacy dispensed wrong medication. Error caught by nurse before administration to patient.
Patient fell while attempting to use bathroom unassisted. Sustained minor bruising, no fractures detected.
Wrong patient identification - error caught during final verification check before procedure.
Surgical count revealed missing instrument. Extended search conducted, item located and removed successfully.
